gloss: branding iron; brand mark; burn mark (stamped with a heated iron)

definitions.gloss: branding iron; brand mark; burn mark (stamped with a heated iron)
definitions.explanation: A mark made by pressing a heated metal stamp onto a surface, or the tool used to make such marks.

examples.japanese: ⟦どら{焼|や}き→どら焼き：10393_dorayaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焼|や}き{印|いん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: To press a brand mark onto a dorayaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{木箱|きばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼|や}き{印|いん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: This wooden box has a name branded into it.
Japanese confectionery shops often use branding irons with their shop name.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (to burn/grill) and {印|いん} (mark/seal). In Japanese traditional crafts, branding irons are commonly used to mark wooden products, leather goods, and sweets. Japanese confections like ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧ and ⟦どら{焼|や}き→どら焼き：10393_dorayaki⟧ often bear the shop's brand mark as a decorative element.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{印|いん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to brand, to press a mark
- {焼|や}き{印|いん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put a brand mark on
- {店名|てんめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}き{印|いん}: brand mark with the shop name

RELATED WORDS:
- {烙印|らくいん}: brand, stigma — can also be used figuratively for a mark of shame
- ⟦{刻印|こくいん}→刻印：29469_kokuin⟧: engraving, stamped mark — carved rather than burned
- ⟦{印|しるし}→印：03254_shirushi⟧: mark, symbol — broader term for any kind of mark
